A septic screen including an ascitic tap (sent for white cell/polymorph count (PMN) and culture, protein and albumin) should be performed to rule out infection, irrespective of inflammatory markers. Coagulopathy and/or thrombocytopenia are not a contraindication to an ascitic tap and checking/correction of coagulation is not required prior to the procedure.

A Doppler ultrasound scan of the abdomen should be performed to look for hepatic/portal vein thrombosis, hepatocellular carcioma and ascites.
